content: Implement query builder and search service with pagination
activeForm: Implementing query builder and search service with pagination
description: Implement user-search.service.ts with buildSearchQuery, applyFilters, and formatSearchResults methods for constructing dynamic SQL queries based on search parameters. Implement query builder functions (buildWhereClause, addJoinClauses, addOrderBy, addPagination) for safe SQL generation with parameterization. Create pagination.service.ts with paginateResults and calculatePageInfo for consistent result pagination with limit/offset and total count metadata. Write 8 MVP-tier tests (4 unit tests for query builder logic covering WHERE clauses, JOIN generation, ORDER BY, and SQL injection prevention; 4 integration tests for pagination consistency, total count accuracy, ordering across pages, and edge cases). This subtask builds on the repository layer (T5.1) and provides the search logic layer that will be consumed by the controller in T5.3.
